summary: Well-architected code but incomplete delivery. Workflow references test files and fixtures (ok-basic.json, ok-include-exclude.json, fail-oversized.json, pipeline.json, package.json, bun.lock, tsconfig.json) that don't exist—`bun test` will fail with no tests, and `run-cases.sh` has no fixture cases. Action refs use major-version pins (acceptable) not commit-pinned (security best practice). Hard-coded EXPECTED_JOB_SUCCESSES=4 (line ~61, act-harness.ts) is fragile if matrix size changes. Cannot execute as provided.
